Match Image 1 exactly for colors, shapes and simplified low-noise cel rendering. Clean dark line, large flat colors, one hard shadow per material. Show separate isolated orthographic detail drawings with generous spacing; no full-body character, invisible mannequin, scenery or effects. NO text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, logos or watermarks.
DETAILS: headscarf and two braids, backpack front/back harness and blanket straps, square lantern, pocket ledger open/closed, coin purse.
EXACT RULES: One small square brass hand lantern with amber glass, one palm-size brown sales ledger with ONE leather strap, one round brown coin purse tied at RIGHT waist. Backpack has TWO leather vertical straps and one large plain flap.
HARD LOCKS: 前辫2条; 蓝头巾; 方背包1; 顶部卷毯1; 灯为方形琥珀; 钱袋右腰. Every physical object appears once; front/back/side or open/closed views are alternate views of the same item. No extra decorative filler.
